push.title: L 1-4 vs Bodtkaa Junior | You: 8.1 (2nd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, an 8.1. That's your 2nd worst match performance of the season. Honest football.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Bodtkaa Junior's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 2. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ On-ball actions 40, up from your usual 28. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ 4 goals conceded was worth +0.2 all by itself.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Simple fix: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Practice makes permanent.
- 69% passing (22 of 32). Here's a thought: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 0. From the clipboard: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.
- That 8.1 sits as your 2nd worst match performance of the season. Next one's the bounce-back.
- Funny thing: BellyTb1 wrestled with shot selection too. Two heads, one fix: cut it back to each other.

Drill: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Hey buddskees, hold onto this one: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Every game teaches us something. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-4 vs Bodtkaa Junior | You: 7.0 (2nd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.0 is your 2nd worst match performance of the season. You've got better ones in you, and we've both seen 'em.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 21 attempts, up from your usual 73%. You found the open man like a dog finds the couch.
+ 6 shots at Bodtkaa Junior's goal. Shots are tickets to the goal lottery, and you bought a stack.
+ 2 key passes. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ Tackle success 67%, up from your usual 26%. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ buddskees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.

THE BAD
- 3 of 6 shots on target. Key note: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- 7.0, your 2nd worst match performance of the season. Learn it, leave it.
- shot selection snagged you and buddskees both. Buddy system: cut it back to each other.
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 4 and set up a relegation match. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 21 (best was PhogsToffees's 35). We'll drill that till it's boring.

Rondo time: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

Good effort, better days ahead. - Coach Lasso
